about: Hurco VM1, self-made in Blender (sources/hurco/build_hurco.py) from dealer photos (warm-white enclosure; the left panel lettered HURCO over a tall blue panel with 'VM1'; two doors with tall round-cornered windows in rubber gaskets and bar handles over a black kick stripe; the slate blue-grey MAX pendant hung off the right front on its arm, with its screen, coloured keys, keypad, jog knob, beige keyboard tray and grab handle; on the roof the tool changer's rounded hood, the electrical box, the head cover, spindle motor and black cable carrier) and the record's specs: inside, the 29 x 14 in table with three T-slots on its saddle, way covers, a blue vise holding a part, the spindle with a CAT40 holder and end mill, coolant hoses and the side-mount 16-tool carousel; behind, the coolant tank and pump, the chip auger and the electrical cabinet door. Doors closed: the work zone shows through the glass.
reviewed: 2026-11-05: modelled against dealer photos; look sheets and three.js before/after checked
